title: Vocabulary
description: The controlled taste vocabulary, committed as src/recommend/vocabulary.json (card R-1, docs/recommend/taste-model.md §2): the facets, the terms on them, and the crosswalk from catalog values to terms. It is configuration, not data. A term has at most one parent, on the same facet, and the tree caps the depth at 3. Cross-checks a schema cannot express (unique ids, parents on the same facet, depth, crosswalk targets exist, no rule maps a dropped value) are in checkVocabulary, src/recommend/vocabulary.ts.

facets.description: The eight facets of taste-model.md §2.1, in display order.

label.description: Short and plain, in the reader's language. No 'you love'.

tagWeightDivisor.description: An ISFDB tag's weight is min(1, count / this): one tagger counts as a third of a strong signal.

generic.description: Case-folded values dropped because they separate nothing on an SF bookcase.

dropPatterns.description: Regular expressions (case-insensitive, run on the case-folded value) for popularity and canon signals: ratings, votes, award and best-of-list tags (OC33). A value that matches is dropped before any rule is tried.

match.description: The case-folded catalog value. For lcsh, the text before the first '--' subdivision.

weight.description: A multiplier in (0, 1]; 1 when absent. For an ISFDB tag it multiplies the tag-count weight.
